categories.main_business_segments: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of high-purity polysilicon products used in the photovoltaic (solar energy) industry. The company also produces silicon core products, trichlorosilane, silicon tetrachloride, sodium hydroxide, hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, and is involved in energy-saving and environmental protection technology promotion services. It operates in the upstream segment of the photovoltaic supply chain, focusing on polysilicon manufacturing and related chemical products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes the improved Siemens process combined with cold hydrogenation technology for polysilicon production, enabling the manufacture of 9N-11N high-purity crystalline silicon suitable for both solar and electronic-grade applications. It has developed proprietary technologies in refining, cold hydrogenation, trichlorosilane reduction, tail gas treatment, and product crushing and screening. The company emphasizes energy recovery, waste recycling, and impurity control to reduce costs and improve product quality, maintaining advanced industry standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are downstream silicon wafer manufacturers in the photovoltaic industry, including producers of monocrystalline and polycrystalline silicon wafers. The company serves mainly the solar energy sector, supplying high-purity polysilicon materials essential for solar cells and modules. Its products are sold domestically across various regions in China and internationally, with a growing presence in overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with production bases in Xinjiang and Inner Mongolia. It serves customers across multiple Chinese regions including North China, Northwest, Southwest, East China, South China, Northeast, and Central China. It also has sales in overseas markets, contributing a smaller but growing portion of revenue. The company’s upstream raw material procurement is localized in western China to leverage regional advantages.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy operates at the upstream segment of the photovoltaic supply chain, specializing in the production of high-purity polysilicon, which is the key raw material for silicon wafers used in solar cells. It controls the supply of industrial silicon powder and related chemical intermediates, positioning itself as a critical supplier to downstream wafer and solar cell manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation focused on improving product quality, reducing production costs, and enhancing energy efficiency. Key R&D initiatives include energy recovery technologies, impurity reduction, advanced process control, and development of N-type polysilicon materials to meet evolving photovoltaic cell technologies such as TOPCon and heterojunction cells. It also invests in semiconductor-grade polysilicon to break foreign monopolies and expand into higher-end markets. Digitalization and intelligent manufacturing are strategic priorities to optimize production and quality control.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-purity polysilicon products to downstream silicon wafer manufacturers under long-term supply agreements and spot sales. The company also earns income from sales of by-products generated during polysilicon production. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and transfer of control to customers, with prepayments received for long-term contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading polysilicon producers in China, ranking in the top tier by production capacity and market share, accounting for approximately 13.83% of domestic polysilicon output in 2023. It competes with other major domestic and international polysilicon manufacturers, leveraging its cost leadership, product quality, and technological innovation to maintain a competitive edge. The company is recognized for its advanced production technology and stable product quality, especially in N-type polysilicon materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 16.33 billion, a decrease of 47.22% compared to the previous year, primarily due to significant polysilicon price declines despite increased production volume. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 5.76 billion, down 69.86% year-over-year. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 50.7 billion, with net assets of RMB 43.9 billion. Production capacity expanded significantly with new projects in Inner Mongolia, increasing nominal capacity to 205,000 tons per year, with further expansions planned.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, low-cost, and low-energy-consumption polysilicon production, supported by advanced proprietary technologies and rigorous quality control systems. It offers products that meet or exceed international standards, with over 99% of output suitable for monocrystalline silicon wafer production and high electronic-grade standards. Its focus on innovation, environmental sustainability, and digitalized manufacturing processes differentiates it in the market, enabling it to supply premium N-type polysilicon materials favored by cutting-edge photovoltaic cell manufacturers.
